ash: Nightly eval alert for int4-2026-03-20 run — legal_faq cohort flagged large increase in 'ambiguous' answers. Examples below, failing on 3/3 prompts. cc @maria @santiago :eyes:

maria: grabbing logs, can you paste the prompt + output samples?

ash: sure:
```prompt
Q: What are the ID verification requirements for refunds?
A:
```
model:int4-v2 -> "We might need bank or driver's ID, check policy." (ambiguous)
model:fp16 -> "A government-issued photo ID and matching name are required for refunds. See section 4.2." (clear)

santiago: interesting, so int4 is collapsing to safe/hedged answers.

elaine: severity? production impact?

ash: severity: P2 for now — affects nightly eval only. No customer reports. Putting as owner: @maria

maria: taking. first step: repro locally with `evaluate --suite legal_faq --model int4-v2 --seed 42`

james: quick check — any kernel changes merged yesterday? @eng-runtime

ops-bot: deploy 2026-03-19T23:50: kernel/quant-optimizations merged by @santiago :rocket:

santiago: that matches. I pushed a small qkernel tweak for int4 mem layout. rolling back to test.

maria: repro run in CI attached -> reproduces 3/3 ambiguous responses. Uploading minimal repro gist: https://gist.github.com/abcd1234

ash: snippet from log:
```
[INFER] model=int4-v2 seq=256 kernel=qk_layout_v2 latency=35ms topk_shift=0.4
[WARN] output_confidence=0.33
```

elaine: might be temperature/topk interplay with quant noise. Can you try `--temp 0.0 --top_k 1` to see deterministic decode?

maria: tried `--temp 0.0 --top_k 1` -> still hedged language, though shorter. So not sampling.

james: hypothesis: quantization introduced bias in logits for legal-style tokens. Can we diff logits fp16 vs int4 for same prompt?

maria: running `logits_diff` on CI, attaching small table in gist.

santiago: rolling back qkernel on a staging node now, running nightly eval subset to compare fp16 vs int4-v1 vs int4-v2.

ops-bot: staging rollback started on node g4-12, job id 98765

ash: thanks. If rollback fixes, plan: hold qkernel, open PR with regression test (legal_faq cohort), and tag runtime on-call.

maria: initial compare: fp16 shows clear logits toward 'requirements', int4-v2 flattened logits and higher prob mass on generic 'check policy' tokens.

james: ok reassigning owners: @santiago runtime kernel rollback + @maria eval repro + @ash coord. :+1:

santiago: if rollback passes I'll open revert PR and add small unit test comparing logit delta for seed 42.

maria: will post final CI diff + ticket to JIRA FR-3421

ash: thanks all. tagging @eng-ml for visibility. Follow-up once rollback results are in. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
